<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>My Swan Flip Clock</title>
<style>
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
  margin: 0; min-height: 100vh; padding: 24px 12px;
  display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at top, #27343d, #08090d 78%);
  color: white; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
}
.container { width: 100%; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; }
.photo-frame {
  width: 100%; max-width: 390px; height: 270px; margin: 0 auto 28px;
  overflow: hidden; border-radius: 18px; background: #19232c;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 35px #0009;
}
.swan {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block;
  object-fit: cover; object-position: center;
}
.heading {
  margin: 0 0 28px; color: #e8d4a5; font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: 5px;
}
.clock {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  gap: clamp(3px, 1vw, 8px);
}
.pair { display: flex; gap: clamp(3px, 1vw, 7px); }
.digit {
  position: relative; width: clamp(31px, 11vw, 72px);
  height: clamp(52px, 16vw, 94px); display: flex;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #343941 0%, #252930 49.5%, #101216 50.5%, #1b1e24 100%);
  color: #fff; font-family: monospace;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 9vw, 59px); font-weight: bold;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 12px #0008;
}
.digit::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%;
  height: 2px; background: #08090c;
}
.digit.flip { animation: flip 0.3s ease-in-out; }
@keyframes flip {
  0% { transform: perspective(250px) rotateX(0); }
  50% { transform: perspective(250px) rotateX(-35deg); }
  100% { transform: perspective(250px) rotateX(0); }
}
.colon { color: #e8d4a5; font-size: clamp(24px, 7vw, 43px); margin-top: -5px; }
.ampm {
  align-self: flex-end; padding-bottom: 7px; min-width: 25px;
  color: #e8d4a5; font-size: 12px; text-align: left;
}
.quote {
  margin: 32px auto 0; max-width: 520px; color: #f0dfbd;
  font-size: clamp(18px, 4.5vw, 26px); line-height: 1.8;
  font-style: italic; text-shadow: 0 2px 12px #000;
}
.date { margin-top: 20px; color: #b8bec7; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.credit { margin-top: 22px; color: #8d939c; font-size: 10px; }
@media (max-width: 360px) {
  body { padding: 20px 6px; }
  .clock, .pair { gap: 3px; }
  .photo-frame { height: 220px; }
  .heading { letter-spacing: 3px; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main class="container">
  <div class="photo-frame">
    <img class="swan" id="swanPhoto" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Two crowned white swans forming a heart">
  </div>
  <h1 class="heading">TIMELESS MOMENTS</h1>
  <div class="clock" aria-label="Current local time">
    <div class="pair"><div class="digit" id="h1">0</div><div class="digit" id="h2">0</div></div>
    <span class="colon">:</span>
    <div class="pair"><div class="digit" id="m1">0</div><div class="digit" id="m2">0</div></div>
    <span class="colon">:</span>
    <div class="pair"><div class="digit" id="s1">0</div><div class="digit" id="s2">0</div></div>
    <span class="ampm" id="ampm">AM</span>
  </div>
  <div class="quote">unakenna manidha uruvathil anna paravaiyadi naan</div>
  <div class="date" id="date"></div>
  <div class="credit">Swan photograph: Your uploaded image</div>
</main>
<script>
function updateClock() {
  const now = new Date();
  let hours = now.getHours();
  const minutes = now.getMinutes();
  const seconds = now.getSeconds();
  const ampm = hours >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  hours = hours % 12 || 12;
  const values = [
    ...String(hours).padStart(2, "0"),
    ...String(minutes).padStart(2, "0"),
    ...String(seconds).padStart(2, "0")
  ];
  const ids = ["h1", "h2", "m1", "m2", "s1", "s2"];
  ids.forEach((id, index) => {
    const digit = document.getElementById(id);
    const value = values[index];
    if (digit.textContent !== value) {
      digit.textContent = value;
      digit.classList.remove("flip");
      void digit.offsetWidth;
      digit.classList.add("flip");
    }
  });
  document.getElementById("ampm").textContent = ampm;
  document.getElementById("date").textContent = now.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
    weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric"
  });
}
updateClock();
setInterval(updateClock, 200);
</script>
</body>
</html>
